run_faiss_retrieve: run the faiss_retrieve script to find nearest neighbors of sentence embeddings using a FAISS index
run_faiss_retrieve_gpu: run the faiss_retrieve script with GPU acceleration to retrieve nearest neighbors from a FAISS index
run_faiss_retrieve_custom_k: run the faiss_retrieve script with a custom K value to retrieve a specific number of nearest neighbors
run_faiss_retrieve_custom_probe: run the faiss_retrieve script with a custom nprobe value to tune FAISS index search precision
run_faiss_retrieve_normalized: run the faiss_retrieve script to load embeddings, normalize them with L2, and retrieve nearest neighbors
